title: Re-enable the navigation-freeze browser regression gate
description: Deep-dive audit 2026-08-08 verified that e2e/tests/navigation-freeze.spec.ts disables its entire describe block while CI still invokes the suite. Required browser validation can therefore pass with zero executed tests. Evidence: e2e/tests/navigation-freeze.spec.ts and .github/workflows/ci.yml. Re-enable or repair the suite, assert a nonzero executed-test count, and update the completion evidence for TSK-0067/0070/0071.
